name: print-social-yellow-tilted-cards-save-the-date-on-calendar-grid
title: Save the Date Cards over a Tilted Calendar
whatItIs: A light-grey square post with a tilted calendar grid of large black numerals, a stack of a yellow, a black and a pale yellow card reading 'Save the date Wed, October 6', a discount line with a URL, a white Set reminder pill with a bell icon, a circled date and a yellow logo tab at the base; below it a coral-to-teal lock-screen graphic.
whatItMeans: Layered cards on a calendar make the date feel pinned, and yellow with black is instantly attention-grabbing.
techniques: Tilted calendar grid as the background
Stacked cards in yellow and black
Circled date as a hand-drawn cue
White pill button with an icon
Logo tab peeking from the bottom edge

vocabulary.definition: A notice announcing a date in advance.
A calendar grid used as a background pattern.
A button for setting a reminder.
